continuity: The Heavenly Power Demon has refused food, clothing, and other conveniences for three days and will not discuss Dark Heaven despite visibly reacting to its name.
Taekyung suspects that Dark Heaven is deeply connected to, or possibly identical with, the Demonic Cult because of the Heavenly Power Demon's former Cult allegiance and silence.

The Beggars' Sect, Green Shadow Squad, and government troops are actively searching for the murderer of the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, and the government search has reached the areas toward Qingcheng and Emei.
A middle-aged military official and his group killed Jang Il while searching for other Beggars' Sect members near Emei.
plot: Jin Taekyung continues distributing food in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison and tries for three days to coax the Heavenly Power Demon into eating and revealing what he knows about Dark Heaven. The Heavenly Power Demon refuses every comfort and says that torture or death would leave him without regret.

Cheongpung returns with food and a Beggars' Sect letter reporting that the search has shifted from finding the Divine Physician to finding the culprit who murdered the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun. The Beggars' Sect, the Tang Clan's Green Shadow Squad, and government troops are searching across Sichuan, with the government troops expanding toward Qingcheng and Emei while preparing for another possible incident; Jeok Cheongang's treatment remains ongoing.

Jang Il, a twenty-five-year-old two-knot Beggars' Sect Disciple, is killed in a secluded forest two days from Emei by a smiling middle-aged military official who orders his subordinates to find the other nearby Beggars' Sect members.
translation_decisions: Render 원균 as Won Gyun, not Heo Gyun, and render 검남춘 as Jiannan Chun.
Render 삼결 제자, 이결 제자, and 일결 제자 as Three-knot Disciple, Two-knot Disciple, and One-knot Disciple; render 부 분타주 as Vice Branch Leader.
Retain Taekyung's abrupt, sarcastic voice while rendering his exaggerated courtesy toward the Heavenly Power Demon as deliberate coaxing.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung possesses the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal says a special condition is required to appraise it.

The Divine Physician and Mungyeong continue the fifteen-day treatment of Jeok Cheongang in the Sichuan Tang Clan's deepest underground prison using the Myriad-Poison Ring and Cold-Ice Stone; the treatment room remains closed.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison, and Jin Taekyung recognizes him as his Master while guarding him.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord is a one-armed middle-aged martial artist who killed the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord commands hundreds of black-robed hunters summoned through a concealed Mystic Gate Formation and intends to hunt Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Qilian Three Fiends from the Qilian Mountains have submitted to the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
The Heavenly Power Demon is imprisoned in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison with severed limb sinews, a ruined dantian, and heavy restraints after more than forty years of captivity.
The Heavenly Power Demon was once an Elder and commander of the Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult who led the subjugation of Qinghai and opened the first front of its holy war.
The Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult survived the Great Faction War in a diminished state and was driven into the Tianshan Mountains; the Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts later served Dark Heaven.
The Heavenly Power Demon says the Divine Cult's former Cult Leader became corrupt and that the Great Faction War cannot be reduced to a simple division between righteous and evil sides.

The Beggars' Sect, the Tang Clan's Green Shadow Squad, and government troops are searching for the murderer of the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, while the Heavenly Power Demon refuses to discuss Dark Heaven.
open_questions: Will the fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang, and will Venerable Myoryeong recover from the Black Hand Seal?
What special condition is required to appraise the Myriad-Poison Ring?
What is the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven, and what is Dark Heaven's relationship to the Demonic Cult?
Who murdered the Poison King and the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, and can the search identify the culprit?
Can Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan withstand the Western Heaven Demon Lord's planned hunt?
temporary_decisions: Render 한빙석 as Cold-Ice Stone; 서천마군 as Western Heaven Demon Lord; and 만독지환 as Myriad-Poison Ring.
Render 대천마신교 as Great Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and 천마신교, 신교, and 본교 as Heavenly Demon Divine Cult or Divine Cult according to context.
Render 음양쌍귀 as Yin-Yang Twin Ghosts and 양귀 as Yang Ghost.
Render 원균 as Won Gyun consistently.
